english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for man-made objects rather than naturally occurring ones.
This is the all-purpose choice for manufactured or artificial things, including synthetic materials and products rather than natural ones.
Use this when the intended contrast is with something natural, meaning artificial or synthetic rather than naturally occurring.
Use this for things or substances made by people rather than occurring naturally.
